title: Missing-Points Waiting Period and Claim Window by Tier — Finch Circle Desk Reference
content:
A missing-points request in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program asks for the points of a purchase on which the member number was not captured. The waiting period and the proof are the same at every tier; the claim window grows at the upper tiers.

| Tier | Waiting period after the purchase date (calendar days) | Claim window after the purchase date (calendar days) | What identifies the purchase |
|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | 7 | 60 | the purchase record |
| Finch Circle Silver | 7 | 60 | the purchase record |
| Finch Circle Gold | 7 | 60 | the purchase record |
| Finch Circle Platinum | 7 | 90 | the purchase record |
| Finch Circle Diamond | 7 | 90 | the purchase record |
| Finch Circle Icon | 7 | 120 | the purchase record |

## Definitions

- **Waiting period** — the calendar days after the purchase date before which a missing-points request is not accepted.
- **Claim window** — the calendar days after the purchase date within which a missing-points request must be made.
- **Proof** — what identifies the purchase in a missing-points request: the purchase record.

## Reading the table (hypothetical)

- At Finch Circle Platinum the claim window is 90 calendar days; at Finch Circle Icon it is 120.
- At every tier the waiting period is 7 calendar days.
